edges.reason: The chiseled red sandstone pillars mark the cave entrance; player must locate them to find and enter the cave
Polished diorite blocks are inside the cave whose entrance is marked by the red sandstone; must find entrance first
Polished diorite is deep in the dark cave; placing torches lets the player visually identify diorite among stone blocks
The jungle button on a log post marks the jungle grove entrance; player must find it to locate the harvestable leaves above
The jungle area contains logs needed for planks and sticks to craft fences; the button marks where to find these resources
Mining leaves clears the canopy to access upper jungle logs and confirms the player is harvesting in the jungle grove
Cooked mutton is stored in a chest directly adjacent to the honey block; finding it reveals the food supply location
